# E040 -- Snapchat Brand Standards

## Metadata
- **Company:** Snapchat (Snap Inc.)
- **Industry:** Social Media
- **Year:** 2020
- **Source file:** snapchat-brand-standards-pdf.pdf
- **Pages:** 12
- **Language:** EN
- **Pages sampled:** 1-2, 6-7, 8-12

## Brand Strategy
- Titled "Brand Elements Quick Guide" -- external-facing, quick-reference format for third-party use
- Covers do's and don'ts of using Snapchat brand elements (word marks, design marks, creative tools, design elements)
- Separate Bitmoji Brand Guidelines exist for Bitmoji elements
- Request form required for any use not covered by guidelines
- Friendly, casual tone throughout ("Hi there!", "Thanks for spreading the love about Snapchat! :)")

## Logo
- **Ghost Logo** -- primary mark, used in most contexts
- **App Icon** -- only for showing Snapchat on mobile phone or in context of mobile apps; otherwise use Ghost Logo
- Clearspace requirements specified (details on intervening pages)
- **Snapcodes** -- scannable emblems for adding friends, following Stories, sharing links; can be used on web, social media, packaging, print; must be tested before publication
- Separate Snapcode Usage Guidelines document exists

## Typography
- **Graphik** font family -- full weight spectrum: Super, Black, Bold, Semibold, Medium, Regular, Light, Extralight
- Described as "welcoming while remaining structural and easy to set"
- Primary weights highlighted (specific weights not indicated in text extraction)

## Color
- **Snap Yellow** -- PMS #SNA001 / HEX #FFFC00 / RGB 255, 252, 0 / CMYK 0, 0, 95, 0
- **Black** -- HEX #000000 / RGB 0, 0, 0 / CMYK (Rich) 60, 40, 40, 100
- **White** -- HEX #FFFFFF / RGB 255, 255, 255
- Yellow described as "one of our most important brand elements"
- Minimal three-color palette

## Graphics
- Ghost Logo is the primary graphic element
- Snapcodes function as both functional and brand graphic elements

## Photography
- Not covered in this document

## Applications
- App icon usage on mobile devices
- Snapcodes on web, social media, product packaging, print
- Third-party naming guidelines: do not use "Snap" in domain names, app names, or any branding confusingly similar to Snapchat
- Must not use Snapchat brand elements in third-party brand identity (app icons, logos, product design)
- Must comply with Snap Kit Developer Terms of Service for integrations

## Tone of Voice
- Casual, friendly, approachable ("Hi there!", "We love yellow", "Thanks for spreading the love")
- Playful brand vocabulary evident in typography samples: "Dancing hotdogs", "Rainbow vomit", "Chipmunk voices", "Real friends"

## Outliers
- Very short document (12 pages) -- a "quick guide" rather than comprehensive brand guidelines
- Unusually casual and friendly tone for brand guidelines
- Snap Yellow is extremely saturated (CMYK 0, 0, 95, 0) -- nearly pure yellow
- Rich black specification (60, 40, 40, 100) rather than standard 100K
- References to ephemeral/playful product features in typography samples suggest brand personality integration into the guidelines themselves

## Quality Score
- **2/5** -- Minimal quick-reference guide covering only essentials for external partners; lacks depth in layout, photography, graphics, and detailed usage examples; serves its purpose but is not a comprehensive brand system
